scheme_name: Incentive for the SC Widow Re-Marriage
other_conditions: Application must be submitted within one year of marriage.
No caste or religion restrictions for the spouse.
The couple must reside in Karnataka.
benefits_summary: Widows from the Scheduled Caste community receive an incentive of up to ₹3 lakh upon remarriage, or ₹2.5 lakh if they have previously received a simple marriage incentive.
